name: feast
title_zh: 特征仓库，让训练和上线吃同一口饭
tagline_zh: 训练时算好的特征，上线时不用重算一遍。离线批量、在线实时共用一套定义，模型上线不再提心吊胆。
tagline_en: Stop recomputing features at serving time. Define once, serve both offline training and online inference with.
desc_en: The Open Source Feature Store for AI/ML
why_zh: 把特征定义、存储、服务拆成离线在线两套的团队，迟早被时间差坑一次。Feast 用一套元数据管住两端。
why_en: Teams with separate offline/online feature paths get bitten by skew. Feast unifies metadata and storage so both sides read the.
limit_zh: 只解决特征存储与分发，不管模型训练和部署。需要自己维护 Feast 服务（或云版）。
limit_en: Only manages feature storage/serving, not training or deployment. You host Feast yourself (or pay for cloud) and still write the compute logic.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
